title: Named after somewhere else: mapping the places named after other places
excerpt: I mapped the 3,981 settlements Wikidata says are named after another place. Most names come from a river or the town next door, but 14% crossed an ocean, and Britain gave away more names than anywhere else.
seo_description: A map of 3,981 places named after other places: rivers, hills and towns next door, and the British names that crossed the oceans.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Named after somewhere else' in black and red on pale paper, beside a world map criss-crossed by thin coloured great circles: a red bundle from Britain to the eastern United States and another to Australia and New Zealand. Text: 3,981 places named after another place, and how far the names travelled.
